text: Pit Airborne Division has completed boarding.
Seventh mechanized inventory team has completed boarding.
17th Special Engineering Squad, report we're boarding immediately.
So you're really going, aren't you?
It's our responsibility, too.
Besides, if I go to Moscow, I may get some of my memory back.
And if that happens, I'll be able to love you even more than I do now.
Wait for me. I want to be with you, but first I've got to destroy this terrible factory of theirs.
Jamie, when I get back...
Let's try living together again. What do you say?
13 Special Operations Squad and Long Chapter Personnel, report immediately for the departure.
We'll be waiting for you, too.
Katrina! Mika! You're here, too?
You better be happy, Buster, with all these beautiful women seeing you off.
I'm happy you came. Let me introduce my wife.
Jamie Seed. I suppose it's a little odd introducing myself a second time, though.
What do you mean? You've never met them before, have you?
What are you talking about, Gillian? We're good friends.
Huh? Since when?
It's the first time I've met her in person, but I've spoken with her on the video phone a lot of times.
What? Have you guys been talking about me behind my back?
